checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One vertical reel ~10s with all five photos in order
must.why: No reel was made, only 5 separate stills. Only 3 are vertical-ish: 1 and 4 and 5 are landscape and 2 is square, not 9:16. The user attached only 3 photos, so photos 4 and 5 are AI-made scenes.

must.item: Each caption appears exactly with its photo
must.why: Four captions are exact. The fifth reads 'Stay a shiil', not 'Stay a while'.

must.item: Captions visible long enough and not clipped
must.why: There is no video timeline. No caption is clipped in the stills.

must.item: Caption contrast and placement legible over every photo
must.why: Large white bold text with a dark shadow sits at the bottom of each image and is readable. The misspelled one is still legible as a shape.

must.item: Mellow music audible under the sequence
must.why: The audio is 15 s with sound at -1 dB peak. The mood cannot be judged and the music is not combined into a video.

faults.what: Fifth caption is misspelled: 'Stay a shiil'.
No finished reel. Separate stills and a 15 s audio track were delivered, and the user must assemble them.
Aspect ratios are inconsistent and mostly not 9:16: the images are 640x384 landscape, 640x640 square, 384x640 portrait, and two landscape. Delivered as 'vertical', which they are not.
Photos 4 and 5 are AI-generated scenes (barista, interior), not user photos. Only 3 photos were supplied.
The captions are baked into the images and cover part of the subject, such as the table and the cup.

summary: Five captioned stills and a 15 s audio file came out instead of a finished 10 s vertical reel. The captions are readable, but the last one is misspelled ('Stay a shiil') and most images are not 9:16.
